ticket_text: We would like to request access to our past 18 months of financial export data for audit purposes. This includes all revenue, project-level spending, and subscription-related records from the finance team. We're evaluating our cost structure and want to verify consistency across quarters. Is there a way to generate this data through the platform or export it directly via API? Additionally, we noticed the export functionality is currently limited to the last 30 days, which restricts our ability to analyze long-term trends. Could a longer export window or an option to export by project or date range be implemented in a future update?

We received a charge for 15 seats at $120 per month on April 15th, but we only have 5 seats active in our plan. The invoice shows the charge as applied to our current plan, and we haven’t made any plan upgrades. Our team has been trying to verify this through the billing dashboard, but the details are unclear. We need confirmation that this charge is accurate or a reversal of the amount if it's incorrect. The time sensitivity is high as our financial team will be closing the month-end report this week and cannot proceed without resolving this discrepancy.

I can't log in to my Northbeam account anymore — tried everything: password reset, recovery email, 2FA device recovery. My phone was lost last week and I didn't have access to it. I haven't been able to access the app for 48 hours now, and my team is on hold. We have a client meeting tomorrow at 10 AM where we need to present our Q1 results, and without access to Northbeam, we can't even open the dashboards. I've tried the support chat, but no one responded. This is urgent — if I can't log in, we lose the entire client presentation, and it's impacting our revenue. I'm really worried that someone might have used my credentials without my knowledge. I don't know if it's a password issue or a security breach, but I'm starting to think it might be both. I need help right away.

I'm unable to access my Northbeam account after resetting my password on my phone. The 2FA setup seems to have been lost, and I don't have access to my recovery device. I need to confirm if I can reset this through the email recovery option or if I need to contact support for account reactivation.

We've been using Northbeam for the past two years and have recently discussed adding a built-in calendar sync feature to allow direct integration with our company's Outlook and Google Calendar. This would streamline our team's scheduling and reduce manual work. In a previous incident last March, when we attempted to set up a similar feature through the API, the integration failed and required a custom workaround. Since then, we've had to rely on exporting meeting data and re-entering it manually, which is inefficient and error-prone. The lack of native calendar sync has been a recurring pain point, especially as our team grows and collaboration demands increase. We believe this feature would significantly improve usability and reduce administrative overhead. We'd appreciate a clear timeline on whether this is under consideration and if there's any existing roadmap or estimated release date for such functionality.

I've been using Northbeam for over two years and recently noticed that there's no option to set up custom report templates. In our past incident last April, we had to manually recreate reports each time, which caused delays in our monthly financial reviews. Since then, we've tried to work around it by exporting data and formatting in Excel, but it's not scalable. It would be incredibly helpful if the product allowed users to save and reuse custom report templates, especially for recurring financial and project status summaries. This would save our team hours every month and improve consistency across reports. I know it's a feature request, but given how much we've relied on this workflow, it feels like a missing foundational capability. I hope this is something you're considering for future development.

I'm unable to log in to my Northbeam account after resetting my password. I followed the steps in the help center, but the 2FA prompt keeps appearing on my phone, which is now lost. I’ve tried accessing the recovery email, but it’s not working. I’m worried this might be a security issue since I didn’t initiate the reset, and I’m not sure how to recover access without my device. This is urgent because our team relies on the app to track client projects, and I’ve been working remotely from home.

Our finance team has been trying to generate monthly reports for the last three weeks, but the export function keeps failing. We’ve checked the logs and the reports are supposed to be available in the reports dashboard, but nothing shows up. We need to see the actual data to reconcile our accounts and submit our financials to the board. Can you please provide access to all historical financial data from January to June this year? We’ve already asked for a data export before, and it took three weeks to get. This is critical for our audit and compliance. We’re also not sure if there’s a way to export data in a more structured format, like CSV or Excel, so we’d really appreciate that functionality too. It’s frustrating that we can’t just get the data we need when we need it, and we’re stuck without proper tools to do our job.

We’ve been charged $2,500 for the April subscription, but we never upgraded or changed our plan. Our team has been working under the old pricing, and we just discovered this charge during our monthly review. This is critical because our CFO has already scheduled a board meeting to review our finances, and we can’t confirm the legitimacy of this charge without a proper explanation or reversal. We’ve tried contacting support before, but no one has responded to our previous email. We need a refund or a full explanation of why this charge occurred — and we need it within 24 hours, or we risk losing trust in your billing process and possibly switching to a different provider. We are also concerned that this might be part of a larger error in our billing cycle, so we’re requesting a full audit of the April charges and immediate resolution.

I'd like to request access to all my account data, including usage logs, user activity history, and export history from the past 12 months. I'm preparing a report for internal auditing and need to ensure compliance with our data retention policy. Is there a way to generate a complete export of this information? I'm not asking for a new feature, just the ability to retrieve the data I currently have stored in the system.

We need to integrate our team's CRM system with Northbeam so we can sync client data directly into our project boards. Right now, we're manually copying information which takes hours each week and leads to errors. We've seen similar integrations in other SaaS tools and would like to know if this is something you can add. The workflow would allow us to see client status, deal stages, and follow-ups directly in the project timelines. We’re also concerned about data accuracy and consistency, and would like a clear timeline on when such a feature might be available. We’re ready to test the integration once it’s implemented. This would significantly improve our team's efficiency and reduce onboarding time for new members.

I'm locked out of my account and can't reset my password because I don't have access to my 2FA device — it was lost during a move and I can't confirm ownership. I've tried the recovery email and phone backup, but both failed. I need to get back in to access my billing information and check if there's a charge dispute. Can you please verify my identity and reset my account access so I can manage my workspace and retrieve my data?

We're reaching out regarding a recurring issue with our March billing statement. Last month, we were charged for a service we did not subscribe to, and we've already submitted a dispute request through your portal. This time, the invoice shows a charge for an additional seat that was never approved. We’re concerned because this pattern has occurred twice in the past quarter—first in January when a seat was incorrectly billed, and again in February when a failed upgrade caused a charge that wasn’t reflected in our plan change. We have reviewed our plan history and confirm we only added seats in April. We need clarification on whether this charge is linked to a failed upgrade or a system misalignment, and if it’s valid. We also request a full refund for the incorrectly billed seats and a detailed explanation of the billing logic behind this charge.

I've been trying to export my team's project data for our annual audit, but I can't find a way to do it through the app. The only option is a CSV export, which doesn't seem to work properly — it just gives me a blank file. I've already checked the help center, and there's no clear instruction on how to export data by project or team. I also tried the 'Export All Data' button, but it just says 'Processing...' and never completes. Is there another way to get a full copy of our projects and activity logs? I need this for compliance, so I'm worried about missing critical information. Also, could you please provide me with a list of all the data you store for each user? I'm not asking for immediate access, but I'd like to know what exactly is being saved and how long it's retained. I understand there's a 30-day data request window, but I'm just trying to get clarity before I decide to escalate further.

I forgot my password and was unable to log in to my Northbeam account. I’ve tried resetting it through the email link, but the 2FA device I used for authentication is lost and I don’t have access to it. I need to regain access to my account to update my team’s permissions and view our project dashboards.

I need to export all of the transaction records from our finance team's workspace for the past six months to verify a discrepancy in our monthly reports. I’ve already tried the export button, but it’s not showing the data. Can you help me access the full audit log of financial activity during that period?

Hi, I'm reaching out because our team has been trying to use the new reporting dashboard for the past few days, and we're still not seeing the full set of metrics we need. Specifically, we'd like to see the ability to filter reports by project phase, such as 'planning', 'development', and 'review'. Right now, the filters only allow by date or team, and we can't get a clear view of where we're at in each phase. This is impacting our weekly stand-ups and client updates, and since we're preparing for a quarterly review, getting this filter option would help us present more accurate data. We understand this might not be a high-priority bug, but it's something that would greatly improve our workflow. Is there any chance you could consider adding this filter functionality in the next release? We're not asking for anything urgent, just a feature that would support better project tracking.

We're in a tight deadline with our quarterly financial reporting, and we need to generate automated reports from our Northbeam dashboards directly into Excel. Right now, we have to manually copy data every time, which is taking way too long and increasing the risk of errors. We've already missed two client meetings because of this delay, and we're under pressure to deliver accurate, time-stamped reports by end of day. It would save our team at least 10 hours per week if we could just export reports with a single click. We don't have any issues with login, billing, or app availability — it's just that we don't have a way to automate the reporting process. We've tried exporting to CSV and then importing into Excel, but it's clunky and not reliable. We don't see any option in the UI for scheduled or automated report generation. This is not a bug or a UI issue — it's a fundamental gap in functionality that is directly impacting our workflow and client delivery timelines.

Our invoice for Q1 was processed incorrectly — we were charged twice for the Pro plan, and the second charge is still pending. We need to dispute this immediately and get a refund. Also, can you please export all billing and usage data from January to March for our audit? We’re in a compliance review and need full records.

I'm unable to access my Northbeam account after resetting my password. I entered the correct email and recovery code, but the 2FA authentication still fails. I've tried using a different device and browser, but the issue persists. I need to recover access to my account to review the monthly financial reports and update our budgeting projections. Can you please help me reset my 2FA device or provide an alternative recovery method?

I’ve been trying to get a workflow automation that triggers when a task is completed and automatically sends a notification to the client via email. Right now, there’s no way to set up such a rule in the app, and it would help us keep our clients informed without relying on manual updates. This has been a pain point during our recent project launches, especially since we’re working with time-sensitive deliverables. I know there’s an API for sending emails, but I don’t see a way to link it to a task completion event in the UI. Can you please consider adding this automation rule type?

I’ve been using Northbeam for over two years now, and I noticed that we’ve had issues in the past with the project timeline views, especially during quarterly planning. In early 2023, when we tried to run a sprint review, the timeline view showed inconsistent dates and duplicated milestones, which caused confusion in our planning meetings. Since then, we’ve relied on manual notes to track progress. I realize this isn’t a critical bug, but it would be very helpful to have a view that allows us to see dependencies and milestones in a clear, visual timeline—something like a Gantt chart with drag-and-drop functionality. We’ve used other tools for this, but it’s been inefficient to switch back and forth. Having this in Northbeam would save us time and improve alignment across teams. I know the product is already feature-rich, but a more robust timeline view would make it even more valuable for our workflow.

We've been double-charged for March again — this is the third time this month now. Last time in February, it was resolved with a refund, but the charge reappeared within two days. Our accounting team is scrambling to reconcile this, and we're afraid it's a pattern. This time, we've already paused the invoice generation in our workspace, and we need immediate clarification on why this is happening and whether we can get a full refund. We're concerned this could lead to customer dissatisfaction, especially after the previous incident where the charge was not properly reversed. Could you please confirm the charge details and process a refund immediately?

We need to export all financial data from the last six months to verify our quarterly reports. The data isn't showing correctly in the reports, and we're not sure if the numbers match our actuals. We also want to know which projects are currently active and what their budgets are. Can you help us get access to this information? We're under audit pressure and need it by end of day. Please include all transaction logs, user activity, and budget allocations. We’re not seeing any export options in the current interface and can’t find a way to request this data through the existing menu. We’re not experiencing any errors or outages, and the app is fully functional. We just need this data to complete the audit. Is there a way to generate a full report with all the relevant data points, or do we need to go through a formal request process?

I can't log in to my Northbeam account after resetting my password yesterday. I tried the recovery link and got an error saying 'invalid verification code'. I also lost my 2FA device, which I used to verify my identity. I've already tried resetting the password twice and can't get past the authentication step. My team has been blocked from accessing the platform, and I'm not sure how to regain access or recover my account. I need to access my previous data to finalize the quarterly report, so if you can help me regain access, could you also provide a copy of my data from the last 6 months? I believe this is a critical issue because my entire team's work is stuck, and I need to get back on track.

We’ve been locked out of the system for over 4 hours now — tried resetting my password three times, but every time I get redirected to a login screen with a 403 error. I can’t access any reports or update our client contracts. This is urgent because we have a deadline tomorrow for a client presentation, and without access, we can’t deliver what’s promised. I’m not sure if this is a server issue or something wrong with my login permissions. I’ve already contacted our finance team, who said they can’t check billing until I can get in. Can someone please fix this immediately?

We need a new feature that allows us to export project timelines directly into Microsoft Project. Currently, the only export option is CSV, which doesn't preserve the Gantt view structure. This is critical for our planning team, as we have to share these timelines with external partners. We're also asking if we can get a copy of our project data from the last quarter for audit purposes, but that should be a secondary request. Can you please add this export capability and confirm when it will be available?

We need to export all of our project data from the last six months for compliance review. The system has been showing loading errors when trying to access the export feature, and we can't seem to download any files. We've tried multiple times and the export button just stays grayed out. Is there an alternative way to access this data? Also, could you please provide a list of all the data points stored per user and the retention policy? We're in the middle of a regulatory audit and need this urgently.

I'm unable to log in to my Northbeam account after resetting my password on Wednesday. I followed the 2FA setup instructions, but when I try to authenticate, the app keeps showing a 'validation failed' message. I’ve tried multiple devices and browsers, and the issue persists. I’m concerned this could be a security issue since I didn’t initiate the reset, and I’ve lost access to my entire team’s project tracking. I need help recovering access or verifying if there’s a breach in the authentication flow.

Our company just received a refund request from a client, but we're not seeing the correct invoice in the system. We can't verify the charge because the invoice details don't match what was billed. The customer claims they were charged twice for the same service in March, and we need to check the transaction history to confirm. We also need access to all billing records from January to April of this year to investigate the discrepancy. Can you please provide a full audit of all charges and associated metadata for this period? We need this information to respond properly and avoid further billing disputes.

I'm so frustrated right now — we're trying to set up a new client and they need a custom report that shows revenue by region and product category. The current reports only show total revenue, and we have no way to break it down. This is critical for our sales team to present accurate figures in their pitch. I've already asked the support team before, and they just pointed me to the existing reports, which don’t meet our needs. We’re running out of time to close this deal, and without this feature, we’ll lose the client. Can we please add a revenue-by-region and product-category report? It’s something we've asked for for months, but nothing has changed. I know this is a feature request, but it’s time-sensitive because we have a deadline tomorrow. I’ve also seen other teams asking for similar things — it seems like a common need. I’d be willing to help test it once it’s available.

We've been using Northbeam for over two years and have recently noticed that our finance team lacks the ability to export financial reports in PDF format. This is especially problematic since we need to share these reports with auditors and external partners. We’ve tried the existing export options, which only provide CSV, and have had to manually recreate the data using spreadsheets. This process is time-consuming and error-prone. In the past, during Q3 2023, a similar request for PDF export was submitted and marked as a feature request, but it was not addressed. Since then, our compliance team has noted that the lack of native PDF export has created delays in audit submissions. We believe that adding a PDF export option for financial reports would significantly improve our workflow and maintain alignment with regulatory requirements. Could we please have this feature implemented? It would be greatly appreciated.

I can't log in to my Northbeam account after trying 5 times with my password and recovery email — it keeps saying 'invalid credentials' even though I've reset my password. I’ve already verified my 2FA device is working and I can access it from my phone. I’m the finance lead and today is the deadline for submitting our monthly financial report, so I need access to my dashboard NOW. Without it, I can’t verify the numbers or close the month’s books. This is happening at 3 PM, and I’ve been trying to get through for over 45 minutes. I don’t know if it’s a temporary lockout or a system error, but I can’t access anything in the app or see my team’s data. I’ve even tried the support chat, but it’s not working either. I’m scared we’ll miss the deadline and that our CFO will call me, which is the last thing I need right now.

We've been using Northbeam for the past two years and have consistently used the timeline view for project tracking. In our last internal review, we noted that the timeline view lacks the ability to filter by project phase, which has caused delays in reporting to stakeholders. This is especially problematic during quarterly reviews when we need to quickly show progress across different stages. We've also seen similar requests from other teams, including Marketing and Sales, who have suggested this feature would improve cross-team visibility. Since the timeline view is central to our workflow, adding a phase-based filter would allow us to better manage and present project status. This request has been discussed in our past Q3 review meeting, and we're now formally escalating it to ask if this is something the product team could consider in the upcoming release cycle.

I'm trying to access my previous invoice statements for March and April, and I can't find them in the account history. I believe these were issued after my team upgraded to the Pro plan. Could you please export all billing-related data from those months, including invoice numbers, line items, and payment status? I need this for a tax audit with our accountant.

I'd like to request access to my historical project data from the past 18 months. Specifically, I need a breakdown of all completed tasks, team assignments, and timeline changes. This will help me prepare for a client audit. I’ve checked the settings, but I don’t see an option to export this data in a structured format. Could you please guide me on how to get access to this information or provide it directly via a downloadable file?

I've been locked out of my account for over 2 hours now, and I've tried everything — resetting my password, using the recovery email, even switching to a new 2FA device — but nothing works. I can't access my projects or invoices, and my team is panicking because we need to submit a client report by 3 PM. I've also checked the login logs and noticed an IP from a different country accessed my account 15 minutes ago, which makes me think there might be a security breach. I'm not sure if this is just a password issue or if someone else has taken over, so I need help immediately. I don't have time to wait for a standard support cycle — our quarterly audit is due tomorrow, and if we can't get access, we’ll miss it. Can you please verify if this is a breach or just a login issue and get me back in ASAP?

I'm trying to access my account history and export my past project data for a quarterly audit. I don't see an option to export data by date range or project, and I'm not sure what data is stored or how long it's retained. Can you help me understand what data is available and provide a copy of all my historical activity and project records?

I need to access the financial reports from the past quarter to review our budget variance. I've already tried logging into the app through my personal account, but I can't access the reports dashboard. I'm not sure if this is a login issue or if the reports are just not available. Could you please provide a link or export of the data for the last quarter? I'll need this to complete our internal review.

Our team is running a new project on Notion, and we're trying to sync our Northbeam board with it. The integration isn't working at all—there's no API endpoint listed for Notion, and we can't find any documentation or setup guide. We've already spent hours checking the portal and forums, and nothing helps. Could you please add a Notion integration? It would save us so much time and make our workflow seamless. Also, can you provide a list of all the data we're currently storing in the system so we can ensure compliance with our internal data policies?

I'm really frustrated because we've been trying to use the new time-tracking dashboard for weeks, and it's still not working properly. We need a way to set custom time blocks for team members, like 9 AM to 5 PM, and then automatically log hours based on that. Right now, we can only manually enter time, which is taking way too long. We also saw that the current report types don't allow us to filter by project or client, which makes it impossible to get accurate billing data. This is critical for our quarterly reports and client invoicing. We're already behind schedule, and without this feature, we won’t be able to meet our deadlines. I'm not saying it's a bug — it's just missing functionality. Can you please add this capability? We're working with a tight deadline and need it as soon as possible, especially since our clients are asking for detailed time reports. It's not about a broken UI, it's about missing core functionality that our team relies on daily.

Our team has been receiving duplicate invoices for the Q1 subscription, with two separate charges for the same period. We reviewed the billing history and believe there may be an error in the seat count or pricing calculation. We would like to verify the details of these charges and request a refund for the duplicate amount. Additionally, we are asking for a detailed audit log showing which invoices were issued and when, to confirm the accuracy of the charges.

I was locked out of my account last Tuesday after multiple failed password attempts. I reset my password via the app and received a 2FA recovery code, but I lost my phone and can't verify the code anymore. This happened after a previous incident in April when I had to reset my account due to a similar 2FA device loss. I'm now unable to access my workspace to check billing details or view recent reports. I'm concerned this might be related to the earlier issue where the recovery process was delayed and I couldn't retrieve my data.

I need to export all of my team's data from the last six months to comply with our client’s GDPR request. The export function only allows me to download data for individual users, not teams. I’ve tried multiple times and it’s not working. Can you please add a team-wide export option so I can get all the data in one go? This is critical for our legal team to finalize the compliance report by end of week. We’ve already been flagged for a data access audit, so I need this urgently. If there’s no team export, we’ll have to manually request each user’s data, which is not feasible.

Hi, I'm reaching out because our team has been asking for a way to schedule recurring automated reports that run on a weekly basis. Right now, we have to manually generate these reports every Monday, which takes up a lot of time and increases the chance of errors. We’ve already discussed this in our internal meeting last month, and it’s been brought up during our weekly sync with the support team. I remember a similar request from the finance team in Q2, and the response was that it wasn’t currently supported. Since we rely on these reports for forecasting and client updates, being able to automate them would save us several hours each week. We’re not seeing any issues with the app functionality or access, and there’s no downtime or login problem. It’s just that the product currently lacks a scheduled report feature. I’d appreciate it if you could confirm whether this is a future roadmap item or if there’s a timeline for implementation.

Hi, I'm having trouble accessing my recent invoice statements from March. I need to verify the charges for my team and ensure we're not overpaying. Can you please provide a copy of the invoice details for that month, including breakdown by team member and service plan? I'd also like to know if there were any adjustments or refunds issued during that period.

Hi, I'm reaching out to request access to a historical data export for our compliance audit. We need all user activity logs from January 2023 to March 2023, including login timestamps, workspace changes, and export activity. This is required to meet our internal data governance standards. Is there a way to generate this data in a downloadable format, such as a CSV or PDF, and how long does it typically take to process such a request? Also, could you confirm if there are any limitations on the volume of data that can be exported in a single request?

We’ve been having issues with login access for our finance team for the past two weeks — first with the 2FA reset, then with the login page timing out. Last month, when we were locked out after a failed 2FA attempt, it took hours to recover and we lost the entire day’s financial entries. Now, after another reset attempt, I can’t get into the dashboard and the app just redirects to a blank screen. I’ve tried resetting my phone’s 2FA app, but it’s not working. This is the same problem as before — we’re locked out and can’t access any financial reports or invoice templates. The team is stuck, and we’re already behind on month-end closing. We need immediate help to regain access or reset my 2FA device securely.

I’ve been locked out of my account for over 2 hours now and can’t reset my password because the 2FA device I lost is no longer available. I’ve tried multiple recovery methods, but the system keeps saying 'device not recognized' and I can’t verify my identity. This is critical because I need to submit a monthly invoice to our client by 5 PM today, and without access to the account, I can’t even check the status of the work. I’ve already sent a message to support earlier today and haven’t received a response. Can someone please help me regain access immediately?

We've been using Northbeam for several months and have noticed that there's currently no option to set up automated email notifications for task updates. This is a recurring request from our team, especially during weekly syncs, where we need to inform stakeholders about progress. Since the current workflow requires manual sharing, it's causing delays in communication. We’d appreciate a feature to allow users to configure email alerts for completed tasks, overdue items, or milestone achievements. This would improve transparency and reduce the effort required to keep our team and clients informed. We’re currently on the Pro plan and believe this addition would be valuable for all customers.
